scope: Currently operating, predominantly bachelor-degree, public and private nonprofit institutions in the 50 US states and DC with enrolled undergraduates.
vintage: Most recent non-null cohorts vary by field; release date is not the reporting year of every metric.

fields.programs: PCIPxx > 0 (share of degrees awarded in broad subject family; not a current program catalog)
fields.programShares: PCIPxx (broad subject share, capped as a ranking signal)
fields.family: OPEID6 (institution family, used to limit repeated campuses)
fields.netPrice: NPT4_PUB / NPT4_PRIV (average annual net price for the defined Title IV cohort, not a personal aid estimate)
